description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawKit's Chat ViewModel, specifically testing the chat flow, session management, model selection, and event handling behaviors.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: A simple actor class used for thread-safe storage of callback values during tests.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: An actor used to create a synchronization point in tests, allowing tests to coordinate asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: An actor that maintains a count, used in tests to track retry attempts or similar counts.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: A class that maintains call counts and logs for interactions with the test chat transport.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: A mock implementation of OpenClawChatTransport used to simulate chat transport interactions in tests.

methods.name: streamsAssistantAndClearsOnFinal
methods.description: Test verifying that the assistant's streaming text is cleared after a final message is received and the chat history refreshes.

methods.name: keepsOptimisticUserMessageWhenFinalRefreshReturnsOnlyAssistantHistory
methods.description: Test ensuring that user messages remain in the chat when history refresh only contains assistant responses.

methods.name: keepsOptimisticUserMessageWhenFinalRefreshHistoryIsTemporarilyEmpty
methods.description: Test verifying that user messages are preserved during a transient empty refresh.

methods.name: doesNotDuplicateUserMessageWhenRefreshReturnsCanonicalTimestamp
methods.description: Test that ensures user messages are not duplicated when the history refresh contains the same timestamp.

methods.name: preservesRepeatedOptimisticUserMessagesWithIdenticalContentDuringRefresh
methods.description: Test that checks repeated user messages with identical content are preserved during history refreshes.

methods.name: acceptsCanonicalSessionKeyEventsForOwnPendingRun
methods.description: Test verifying that external events with the same session key as a pending run are accepted.

methods.name: acceptsCanonicalSessionKeyEventsForExternalRuns
methods.description: Test verifying that external chat events with external run IDs are accepted and result in message history updates.

methods.name: preservesMessageIDsAcrossHistoryRefreshes
methods.description: Test to ensure message IDs are maintained after history refreshes.

methods.name: clearsStreamingOnExternalFinalEvent
methods.description: Test that streaming assistant text is cleared upon receiving an external final event.

methods.name: seqGapClearsPendingRunsAndAutoRefreshesHistory
methods.description: Test that sequence gaps reset pending runs and trigger history refresh.

methods.name: sessionChoicesPreferMainAndRecent
methods.description: Test that session choices prioritize 'main' and recent sessions.

methods.name: sessionChoicesIncludeCurrentWhenMissing
methods.description: Test that current session key is included if missing from session list.

methods.name: sessionChoicesUseResolvedMainSessionKeyInsteadOfLiteralMain
methods.description: Test that the main session key is resolved to a display name and used correctly.

methods.name: sessionChoicesHideInternalOnboardingSession
methods.description: Test that internal onboarding sessions are hidden from session choices.

methods.name: resetTriggerResetsSessionAndReloadsHistory
methods.description: Test that reset command resets the session and reloads history.

methods.name: compactTriggerCompactsSessionAndReloadsHistory
methods.description: Test that compact command invokes session-compact, then reloads history.

methods.name: compactTriggerShowsGenericErrorMessageOnFailure
methods.description: Test that a generic error message is shown if compact hook throws.

methods.name: compactTriggerIgnoresConcurrentAndImmediateRepeatRequests
methods.description: Test that concurrent or repeated compact requests are ignored, with proper messaging.

methods.name: compactTriggerAllowsImmediateRetryAfterFailure
methods.description: Test that after a failure, user can retry compact immediately, and it executes.

methods.name: bootstrapsModelSelectionFromSessionAndDefaults
methods.description: Test model selection initialization from session defaults and history.

methods.name: selectingDefaultModelPatchesNilAndUpdatesSelection
methods.description: Test that selecting default model updates session model and patches.

methods.name: selectingProviderQualifiedModelDisambiguatesDuplicateModelIDs
methods.description: Test that modelID disambiguation works when provider info is present.

methods.name: slashModelIDsStayProviderQualifiedInSelectionAndPatch
methods.description: Test that provider-qualified model IDs stay consistent after selection.

methods.name: staleModelPatchCompletionsDoNotOverwriteNewerSelection
methods.description: Test that older patch completions do not overwrite newer model selections.

methods.name: failedLatestModelSelectionDoesNotReplayAfterOlderCompletionFinishes
methods.description: Test that an older failed patch does not revert a newer successful model selection.

methods.name: failedLatestModelSelectionRestoresEarlierSuccessWithoutReplay
methods.description: Test that prior successful model selection remains after a subsequent failure.

methods.name: switchingSessionsIgnoresLateModelPatchCompletionFromPreviousSession
methods.description: Test that late model patches from previous sessions do not affect current session.

methods.name: lateModelCompletionDoesNotReplayCurrentSessionSelectionIntoPreviousSession
methods.description: Test to prevent late model completion of a different session from overwriting current session.

methods.name: explicitThinkingLevelWinsOverHistoryAndPersistsChanges
methods.description: Test that explicit thinking level overrides history and is persisted.

methods.name: serverProvidedThinkingLevelsOutsideMenuArePreservedForSend
methods.description: Test that server-prescribed thinking levels are taken into account during send.

methods.name: staleThinkingPatchCompletionReappliesLatestSelection
methods.description: Test that older thinking level patch completions do not override the latest selection.

methods.name: clearsStreamingOnExternalErrorEvent
methods.description: Test that assistant streaming is cleared upon receiving an external error event.

methods.name: stripsInboundMetadataFromHistoryMessages
methods.description: Test that embedded meta-data in history messages are sanitized before display.

methods.name: abortRequestsDoNotClearPendingUntilAbortedEvent
methods.description: Test that abort command sets pending state until an aborted event is received.
